title: Data Enclave: A Data-Centric Trusted Execution Environment
problem: Existing TEEs lack support for data management primitives, making data sharing between enclaves either insecure or cumbersome. Inter-enclave cooperation requires complex and inefficient mechanisms that compromise either security or usability.
motivation: Secure cloud computing with TEEs requires efficient and secure data sharing between multiple enclaves to enable practical multi-party applications.
method: Data enclave introduces a data-centric abstraction decoupled from enclave lifetimes with cryptographic isolation and flexible permission controls. It employs dynamic shrinking of integrity tree height to reduce performance overhead while maintaining security, enabling efficient inter-enclave data cooperation without complex data marshaling.
key_novelty: A data-centric abstraction for TEEs that decouples secure data management from individual enclave lifetimes, enabling efficient sharing through cryptographic isolation and dynamic integrity tree optimization.
contributions: Data enclave abstraction as a first-class data management primitive for TEEs
Flexible secure permission controls enabling fine-grained data access across enclaves
Dynamic integrity tree height optimization for improved performance
Architecture support enabling efficient multi-enclave cooperation and data sharing

metrics.speedup: significant efficiency improvement in inter-enclave operations

primary_theme: data-centric secure execution for cloud applications
